instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest is a boutique HR and organizational development consultancy specializing in executive coaching, culture transformation roadmaps, and competency framework design for mid-to-large enterprises. The team of 12 psychologists focuses on delivering high-impact, customized change management solutions that address complex leadership challenges.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully launched a proprietary AI-driven skills gap assessment tool for clients, which allowed us to standardize our diagnostic intake and reduce initial scoping time by 20%. Furthermore, we piloted a hybrid remote coaching model that demonstrated strong client engagement and offered a potential new service line.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on the corporate sector and three major client accounts, representing 55% of our total revenue stream. To ensure long-term resilience, we must aggressively diversify our portfolio by developing specialized vertical expertise and introducing entirely new product lines that utilize our core psychological insights for adjacent markets.
answers.additionalContext: The market is increasingly demanding measurable ROI from consulting services, requiring us to rapidly integrate technology into our service delivery model. We have identified a clear window in the 18-24 month horizon to pivot towards scalable digital solutions.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Diagnostic Engine Integration
opportunities.rationale: Integrating advanced diagnostic AI into our existing assessment process will significantly improve speed and scalability without requiring a complete overhaul of our service delivery model. This leverages our current digital maturity to enhance efficiency.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-potential vendors for psychometric AI tools.
Allocate a dedicated sprint team (1 FTE) for proof-of-concept integration.
resources_needed: 50k USD for pilot licensing and integration testing
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in client diagnostic scoping time by 30% within Q4.

opportunities.title: Subscription-Based Competency Platform (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Moving from project-based consulting to a scalable, subscription-based competency platform would fundamentally diversify revenue streams and decouple growth from billable hours. This radical shift positions Crest as a recurring technology partner rather than just a service provider.

first_actions: Define the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a core training module.
Conduct market validation interviews with 10 non-corporate SME clients.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure first paying subscription client within 9 months.
milestones: Launch pilot program with SaaS pricing model (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Conduct a full market sizing analysis for potential non-corporate verticals (e.g., healthcare or FinTech).
Establish a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' to evaluate the technical feasibility of building the subscription platform MVP.
Review and optimize internal processes to reallocate at least 10% of current team time towards strategic exploration (using existing '20% time' structure).

key_weaknesses: Talent scarcity in specialized AI and platform development roles.
Process rigidity within the formal business case approval chain hindering rapid pivot capability.
Over-reliance on a concentrated client base which limits revenue diversification.
